documentDescription: Learn how to configure static generation in your Next.js application.
Learn how to configure static generation in your Next.js application.
content:
The following options are available:

staticGenerationRetryCount: The number of times to retry a failed page generation before failing the build.staticGenerationMaxConcurrency: The maximum number of pages to be processed per worker.staticGenerationMinPagesPerWorker: The minimum number of pages to be processed before starting a new worker.
